hero.testimonial: Embedded Systems Engineer with comprehensive knowledge of NPWT(V.A.C therapy) systems and their full operational workflow, with hands-on experience working on real-life product development projects at IIT Delhi.

about.description: Parvaj Malik is an Electronics and Communication Engineering graduate with a Post Graduate Diploma in Embedded Systems Design from CDAC. He has worked as a Research Embedded Systems Engineer in collaboration with IIT Delhi and AIIMS Delhi, contributing to real-world product development and biomedical system innovation.

skills.title: Full system designs with H/W and S/W

workExperience.company: Inochi care Pvt limited, New Delhi
workExperience.description: Designing and developing STM32-based NPWT biomedical systems with complete firmware architecture, closed-loop pressure control, sensor integration, and PWM-based pump regulation. Experienced in full hardware-software integration, custom LCD driver implementation over MIPI DSI, and system-level debugging to ensure reliable medical-grade performance.

Served as a Research Embedded Systems Engineer at IIT Delhi, contributing to innovative biomedical product development and a WIPO-supported technology project, focusing on embedded firmware architecture, hardware integration, and system validation. Later promoted to Inochi for advanced product development and end-to-end system implementation.

Completed intensive training in Embedded Systems Design at CDAC, gaining hands-on experience in Embedded C/C++, RTOS, Linux systems, and microcontroller platforms including STM32, ESP32, NXP, and Raspberry Pi. Worked on real-time firmware development, peripheral interfacing (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN), IoT systems, and hardware-software integration.

footer.bio: Research-driven Embedded Systems Engineer focused on biomedical innovation and production-ready medical systems.
